items.prompt: For m queries and a fixed sorted ladder of n prices, which comparison bound fits this independent binary search?

options.text: O(m*n), because every query scans every price.
options.why: The interval is halved instead of scanned linearly.

options.text: O(n log m), because prices are sorted by query.
options.why: The queries do not determine the search-array dimension.

options.text: O(log n) for the entire batch, independent of m.
options.why: Each query requires its own search.

options.text: O(m log n), with O(m) returned output storage.
options.why: Each query halves its own interval and appends one output line.

items.explanation: Each query halves its own interval and appends one output line.
